description.value: Closed-cycle respiration. You don't need to breathe. Immune to inhaled poisons and airborne hazards (gas, spores, smoke, vacuum).

cinderfall.incomplete: 'You don't need to breathe' has no food/breath-clock mechanism to cancel anywhere in pf2e (confirmed absence, same as every other no-need-to-eat/breathe clause in this pass). The Immunity above covers inhaled poisons via the real inhaled trait (pf2e-source/src/scripts/config/traits.ts); 'airborne hazards (gas, spores, smoke, vacuum)' beyond the inhaled-poison trait has no matching trait/predicate, so that broader half of the claim is not modeled -- undercounting rather than overstating, the safer direction per the mutations-pass convention.
